entities.name: Child of Alara
entities.description: A legendary avatar spawned by the Maelstrom, made of all colors of mana, appearing as a large baby of energy.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The Child manifests the Conflux itself.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane the Child is an avatar of.

events.summary: The Maelstrom spawned the Child of Alara, who showed no allegiance or mercy to any of the five shards.
events.quote: The Child of Alara is an avatar that was spawned by the Maelstrom
